description: git-safety advisory hooks. ONE non-fatal PreToolUse hook that inspects a shell command (Bash or PowerShell) and, if it contains a risky git operation shape (git add -A/./-u, reset --hard, clean -fd, stash, checkout -- / restore, push --force, rm --cached), hands Claude ONE short reminder (PreToolUse additionalContext JSON) pointing at the relevant guardrail skill. It never blocks, never denies, never rewrites the command. Exit 0 always.

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/risky_git_advisory.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
